measurement: Canonical USGS centerline compared with runtime data and actual scene metadata. Creek bed samples use the terrain surface shared by renderer and physics. Departure uses fixed-step vehicle physics; moving RAF timing is measured separately. Inspection screenshots require visual review. Channel dimensions and plant placements remain representative, not field measurements.

woodlands.notes: Observed leaf-off wooded ground east of the Beverly back lawns, corroborated by 2013. Polygon follows litter/lawn edge and stops north of West Ridge pavement. Tree spacing is a representative rendering density, not a trunk survey. No property-boundary inference.

stream.name: Stony Creek
stream.source: USGS 3D Hydrography Program / NHD-derived channel line
stream.horizontalConfidence: Mapped stream corridor corroborated by independent OSM and 2013/2025 aerial canopy/ravine pattern; fine bank and meander positions are approximate
stream.crossSourceNote: At local z=0, USGS/NHD lies near x=81m and OSM near x=78m. NYS DEC classification line lies near x=49m and is too generalized for property reconstruction. Aerial reviewer confirms ravine near x=80m.
stream.visualWidthDepth: Not measured; game width, water level, cross section and depth must be labeled visual approximations
stream.renderRecommendation: Clip to reviewed northern extent z=-105m and relevant woodland bounds; stop at least12m from West Ridge road pavement. Preserve original33vertices here and interpolate/clipping only in derived runtime output.
stream.depthStatus: Approximately 0.2 m water depth; inferred ravine cut reconciles the coarse DEM hump with a descending stream. Bank elevations and cross-section are not surveyed.
stream.reachLimit: Only the inspected woodland reach, ending before the existing West Ridge road; no unverified culvert reconstruction.

limits: Mapped stream plan geometry and aerial woodland edge; unmeasured bank grade, stream width/depth, interior stems and plant species are representative.
The local terrain grid refines interpolation of the existing DEM and adds a shallow scenic channel; it is not new lidar elevation.

plants.basis: Representative woodland forms; species and exact placements are not surveyed
plants.geometry: Original folded leaves and tapered segmented stems

render.forestFloor: Original 1.45 m tiled brown leaf litter; matte material; 1.5 m green-earth edge blend
render.limits: Mapped flowline and aerial forest edge; channel cross-section, plants, rocks and fallen wood are representative.
